briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Operators Find Daylight as Washington Turns the Tide on Cannabis and Psychedelics
briefs.top: Michigan's cannabis scene keeps expanding — new Ann Arbor storefronts, a Chris Webber-backed $50M Corktown facility, and a governor's race where the GOP nominee just won the industry's formal endorsement on a tax-repeal pledge — even as the 24% wholesale tax fight finally heads to trial. Nationally, momentum is building fast: a record-breaking FDA psychedelics hearing, Eli Lilly's atai Beckley buy, fresh M&A from Cresco Labs and Vireo Growth, and a federal court win that keeps Schedule III protections intact for medical marijuana operators.

local.text: New Standard opens new Ann Arbor storefront — The dispensary held a Sept. 3-6 grand-opening weekend with giveaways and discounts for shoppers.
Chris Webber launches $50M cannabis facility in Corktown — The NBA legend returned to Detroit to open his latest venture, a $50 million cannabis operation on 22nd Street.

GOP governor nominee James locks in MiCIA endorsement — John James pledged to repeal or sharply reduce the 24% wholesale tax and won a formal endorsement from the Michigan Cannabis Industry Association.
U.P. chain Rize grows by splitting the tax bite — The three-store Upper Michigan operator is sustaining growth by negotiating supplier cost-sharing deals instead of absorbing the 24% tax alone.

Industry's original tax lawsuit finally reaches trial — MiCIA's first challenge to the 24% wholesale tax heads to trial this month, while a second suit argues the levy creates unconstitutional 'tax pyramiding' on consumers.

national.text: FDA's psychedelics hearing draws 18,000 registrants — The historic Part 15 hearing on future therapeutic use of psychedelic drugs pulled over 18,000 registered attendees and roughly 80 speakers.

Eli Lilly closes its atai Beckley psychedelics buy — The acquisition, approved by stockholders and closed Sept. 11, brings pipeline assets BPL-003, VLS-01 and EMP-01 under Lilly's development umbrella.
Cresco Labs closes $50M PharmaCann Penn acquisition — The deal hands Cresco 100% of PharmaCann Penn's equity for roughly $50 million, expanding its multistate footprint.
Vireo Growth's acquisition spree fuels 335% growth — Powered by recent buys, Vireo is closing deals for FLUENT, C21, Planet 13's operations and Cannabist assets across five more states.
Court upholds rescheduling, rejects industry challenge — The D.C. Circuit left the medical marijuana Schedule III order in effect, ruling opponents hadn't shown they'd suffer irreparable harm.
